outcome: perinatal survival at 28 days of life
cohort: The study participants were healthy co-twins from 390 dichorionic twin pregnancies that underwent selective termination for fetal anomalies diagnosed before 24 weeks gestation.
finding: Postponing selective termination until the third trimester significantly improved overall co-twin survival (100% vs 93.8%), whereas immediate selective termination reduced the risk of preterm delivery (<37 weeks gestation: 20.2% vs 66.7%).
gest_age: Fetal conditions were diagnosed before 24 weeks gestation, and outcomes included preterm birth defined as <37 weeks, <28 weeks, and <32 weeks gestation.
